mapper.select: SELECT f.warehouse_id AS "warehouseId", f.material_id AS "materialId", CASE WHEN d.in_transit = 1 AND f.warehouse_id = d.to_warehouse_id THEN d.receive_date ELSE d.biz_date END AS "bizDate", SUM(f.qty) AS "qty" FROM wms_stock_flow f JOIN wms_stock_doc d ON d.id = f.doc_id WHERE f.biz_type IN ('IN', 'OUT', 'TRANSFER') AND f.warehouse_id IN #{id} GROUP BY f.warehouse_id, f.material_id, CASE WHEN d.in_transit = 1 AND f.warehouse_id = d.to_warehouse_id THEN d.receive_date ELSE d.biz_date END

SELECT YEAR(o.ship_time) * 100 + MONTH(o.ship_time) AS "ym", SUM(o.shipping_cost) AS "amount" FROM ecom_order o WHERE o.fulfillment = 'SELLER' AND o.local_status = 'SHIPPED' AND o.ship_time IS NOT NULL AND o.store_id IN GROUP BY YEAR(o.ship_time) * 100 + MONTH(o.ship_time)

SELECT YEAR(i.ship_date) * 100 + MONTH(i.ship_date) AS "ym", SUM(COALESCE(i.freight, 0) + COALESCE(i.duty, 0) + COALESCE(i.other_cost, 0)) AS "amount" FROM ecom_inbound i WHERE i.status IN ('SHIPPED', 'RECEIVED') AND i.ship_date IS NOT NULL AND i.store_id IN GROUP BY YEAR(i.ship_date) * 100 + MONTH(i.ship_date)

SELECT YEAR(a.ad_date) * 100 + MONTH(a.ad_date) AS "ym", s.currency AS "currency", SUM(a.spend) AS "amount" FROM ecom_ad_daily a JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = a.store_id WHERE a.store_id IN GROUP BY YEAR(a.ad_date) * 100 + MONTH(a.ad_date), s.currency
